metadata.title: rate-limiter: harden tenant and tool-based rate limiting — test with new cpex framework changes and fix issues
metadata.author: gandhipratik203

description:
## Summary

The in-flight cpex framework integration ([cpex-plugins#57](https://github.com/IBM/cpex-plugins/pull/57) + [mcp-context-forge#3754](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/pull/3754)) changes the plugin's framework-side surface and could affect rate-limiter behavior. While we revalidate the plugin against the new framework, this is a natural moment to also improve the `by_tenant` and `by_tool` dimensions — both shipped basic and have known gaps.

## Goal

After the framework integration lands:
- Tenant- and tool-based rate limiting handles real operator use cases end-to-end, with gaps fixed.
- Behavior is exercised by gateway-level integration tests.
- `by_user`, `by_tenant`, and `by_tool` continue to interoperate correctly.

## Tasks

- [ ] Once the framework integration is in, run the rate-limiter test suite end-to-end to confirm no regressions across existing dimensions.
- [ ] First step — map operator use cases for `by_tenant` and `by_tool` rate limiting, compare against current behavior, and list the gaps.
- [ ] Implement the improvements identified (e.g. tenant context propagation, tool-name handling, interactions between dimensions).
- [ ] Add gateway-level integration tests covering each tenant- and tool-based use case.
- [ ] Update operator-facing docs to reflect the improved behavior.

## Dependencies

- [cpex-plugins#57](https://github.com/IBM/cpex-plugins/pull/57) — framework imports refactor
- [mcp-context-forge#3754](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/pull/3754) — replace internal plugin framework with CPEX
